title: ranking key v1 plus the Tier C intersection fill over Batt-SLM

key.rule: the key contains gated channels only; an eligible-but-blocked extension channel is refused until its verdict is on disk AND a new preregistration pins its column and direction
key.weights_rule: with no measured cost or benefit ratio between channels the only non-arbitrary choice is equal weight; any other weighting needs a falsifiable reason registered before the run

viscosity.merge_condition: delta <= -0.02 with both arms gate status unchanged
viscosity.action_at_lock: not merged; eta stays out of the key at its W19 reading 0.17477197208762 against the 0.15 gate

safety.merge_condition: the Step-2 modelling verdict is on disk and passes its own gate
safety.action_at_lock: not merged; safety has no gate reading and no pinned key column, so nothing about it can be scored

dedup.rule: at most one column per collinearity group may carry weight; a key that names two columns of one group is refused

domain_gate.rule: NumHDonors(SMILES) >= 1 and TPSA(SMILES) >= 20.0 (D1, from the frozen SMILES alone)
domain_gate.out_of_domain_policy: no score, no rank, never on the Pareto front; min-max normalisation runs inside the in-domain set only, so a rejected row cannot move a kept row score

fill.layer: Tier C (frozen features plus frozen model predictions)
fill.features: rdkit morgan count r2 2048 + 30 rdkit 2D descriptors, the frozen l3 feature block

planned_validations: the example ordering and scores are pinned literally in tests/test_w20_ranking_key_v1.py
the weights are pinned literally and a weight change must move the ranking
an out-of-domain row receives score None, rank None and is never on the front
a key that names two columns of one collinearity group is refused
the module gate table is cross-checked against probes/w19_ranking_key.py
all new files are LF and carry no BOM
